title: Big blaze. Might be his house.
html_source: Bloom wonders if the house on fire belongs to Blazes Boylan.

anchor.text: Big blaze. Might be his house.
anchor.prefix:
What is that? A flasher? Searchlight. 

(He stands at Cormack's corner, watching.) 

 BLOOM 

 Aurora borealis or a steel foundry? Ah, the brigade, of course. South side anyhow.
